LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravTether.label: defense-platform engine
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravTether.description: The central engine of a US Automated Aerospace Defense orbital battery. Built for unending autonomous operation, it generates the lift and stabilization fields needed to keep the sprawling installation in orbit. The assembly is incompatible with a human Hellion, but destroying it yields a valuable reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidHullPlatform.label: defense-platform hull
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidHullPlatform.description: A dense structural block used to form US Automated Aerospace Defense orbital batteries. Its gravlite alloys make it impervious to conventional damage.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidStabilizer.label: defense-platform stabilizer
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidStabilizer.description: A compact astrofuel thruster used to maneuver an automated orbital defense battery. Its mechanically precise construction and thick vacstone lining withstand extreme heat and stress. While unusable by a human Hellion, destroying one yields a small supply of vacstone blocks.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidHeatsink.label: defense-platform heatsink
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidHeatsink.description: A skeletal thermal regulator built into a US defense platform. It absorbs waste heat from the battery's systems and converts a fraction into operational power, preventing engine overheating.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSolarPanel.label: defense-platform solar panel
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSolarPanel.description: A dense grid of hexagonal gravlite solar panels that supplies power to a US Automated Aerospace Defense installation.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidTargetingRelay.label: defense targeting relay
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidTargetingRelay.description: A military relay that transmits precise targeting parameters to nearby automated artillery pieces, dramatically improving their accuracy.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidArtilleryLoader.label: defense artillery loader
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidArtilleryLoader.description: A heavily reinforced conveyor designed to feed slugs rapidly into automated mass drivers. It dramatically decreases the reload time of linked artillery.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravcapacitor.label: defense-platform gravcapacitor
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravcapacitor.description: A dense energy reservoir used to store power for essential orbital-defense systems. Its volatile charge is contained by powerful magnetic fields and detonates as an EMP blast if the unit is severely damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidOvershieldGenerator.label: defense-platform overshield
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSignalJammer.label: defense-platform signal jammer
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSignalJammer.description: A military array that broadcasts localized interference and conflicting navigational signals. It prevents any Hellion or drop pod from approaching, creating an exclusion zone around the installation.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidAuxiliaryProcessor.label: defense-network processor
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidAuxiliaryProcessor.descript: An auxiliary military computer that coordinates local systems within the US Automated Aerospace Defense network.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravfieldAmplifier.label: defense-platform field amplifier
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravfieldAmplifier.descript: An array of gravimetric resonators designed to stabilize and enhance a defense-platform engine, allowing the orbital battery to expand while maintaining structural integrity.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravfieldExtender.label: defense-platform field extender
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidGravfieldExtender.descripti: A support structure that extends the localized lift field of a US defense platform, enabling more complex battery configurations.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidInformationSpire.label: defense information spire
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidInformationSpire.descriptio: A hardened communication structure that exchanges targeting, identification, and formation data with the wider US Automated Aerospace Defense network.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidResourceCrate.label: sealed defense supply crate
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidResourceCrate.description: A sealed military resource container. Its locking system appears impossible to open, and its contents are unknown.
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSensorNode.label: defense sensor node
LanguageData.VGE_MechanoidSensorNode.description: A sophisticated sensor array using advanced optics and gravimetric scanners to monitor orbital activity and transmit real-time tracking data to the US Automated Aerospace Defense network.
LanguageData.VGE2_MechNavBeacon.description: A military navigation beacon used by orbital defense batteries to broadcast precise docking vectors and formation coordinates.
LanguageData.VGE2_MechVertex.description: A mysterious autonomous node within the US Automated Aerospace Defense network. It contains valuable resources but is exceptionally delicate; significant damage causes catastrophic failure of its micro power cells.
